title: Drive Mad

Do not add people, a companion, outside UI chrome, watermarks or floating toolbars outside the physical working surface. All account/content values are fictional. The brand is "Drive Mad". One complete final visual concept only. The actual app is Drive Mad: make its core workflow immediately recognisable. No decorative slogans.
